privacy: Aggregates only. Wallets are pseudonymous proxy-wallet hashes; no addresses, names or per-wallet rows are published, and no attempt is made to identify or locate traders.

definitions.yes: registry YES token (Democratic side, as in markets.json)
definitions.flow: net (and gross = sum of |.|) YES-equivalent USD of taker orders; buckets by taker order size paid (fills of one tx per wallet): small <$100, medium $100-1k, large >=$1k
definitions.seasoned: positive total realised PnL over >= 3 resolved political Polymarket markets of the seasoning universe (all fills, maker and taker)
definitions.holders: top-10 share and HHI (0-10,000) of the YES/NO token over max(open interest, listed top-500 holders' sum)
definitions.age_30d: days since first Polymarket activity, wallets with >= $100 traded in the race in the last 30 days
definitions.lambda_per_1k: OLS price change (0-1) per $1k net taker YES flow per bar, HC1 t
definitions.lead_lag: lead = corr(flow_t, dprice_t+1); follow = corr(dprice_t, flow_t+1)
definitions.series: [date, YES price close, net small, net medium, net large, net seasoned (USD), active wallets]

seasoning_2026.universe: political markets resolved 2023-01 to 2024-10-21 (Gamma tag politics, volume >= $10k) + 2024 Democratic-side Senate/governor/presidential state markets

historical_2024.x_definition: seasoned wallets' net YES-equivalent $ in the window / market gross $ in the window
